_meta.description: ADR-063 read-only x-openregister-mcp dialect on the 12 curated schemas (design.md D2). Adds only configuration["x-openregister-mcp"] per schema via ADR-037 key-union merge: no property, lifecycle, or required-list is restated or altered. Search+get only, scope:read, readOnlyHint:true. Zero write verbs. Sorts last of all fragments (zzz- prefix) so nothing merged afterwards can overwrite the declaration.

search.description: Search accounts-receivable invoices (the AR sub-ledger record of account: the only place amountDue/paidAmount/dunning live). Use for 'which invoices are overdue?' and similar debtor/AR questions.

get.description: Get a single AR invoice by id, including amountDue, paidAmount, and dunning state.

search.description: Search accounts-payable invoices. Use for 'what do we still owe?' and to find invoices stuck unmatched against a purchase order.

get.description: Get a single supplier (AP) invoice by id, including its matching and extraction status.

search.description: Search the debtor master. Use to resolve which customer an invoice or payment question is about, by name, KvK number, or VAT id.

get.description: Get a single customer (debtor) master record by id.

search.description: Search payments. Use to answer 'has invoice X been paid?': the read that closes the loop on an AR or AP invoice.

get.description: Get a single payment by id.

search.description: Search the RGS chart of accounts. Required to resolve any ledger account before reasoning about a posting.

get.description: Get a single chart-of-accounts entry by id.

search.description: Search general-ledger transactions: the double-entry posting of record. Use for 'what was booked in period 6?' and similar posting-history questions.

get.description: Get a single GL transaction by id.

search.description: Search booked hours. Use for 'how many hours did I book on project Y this month?': the top ZZP/consultancy question and the urencriterium input.

get.description: Get a single hours-registration entry by id.

search.description: Search expense claim headers. Use for 'which expense claims are waiting on approval?'. Line-level Receipt rows are reachable through the header and are not separately exposed.

get.description: Get a single expense claim entry by id.

search.description: Search projects, including percentageComplete, wipBalance, and recognisedRevenue: the RJ 270 / IFRS 15 revenue-recognition answers.

get.description: Get a single project by id.

search.description: Search BTW (VAT) returns and their Digipoort submission state. Use for 'is the Q2 BTW-aangifte submitted?'.

get.description: Get a single VAT return by id.

search.description: Search trial balances. Use for 'is the trial balance balanced?': a closing-check read against isBalanced, totalDebits, totalCredits.

get.description: Get a single trial balance by id.

search.description: Search imported bank statement headers. Use for 'did the January statement import, and is it reconciled?'. Line-level BankStatementLine rows are reachable through the header and are not separately exposed.

get.description: Get a single bank statement header by id.
